goal: Complete the UIGS epistemic rebase as an operational, reversible, evidence-governed learning system across the active knowledge lifecycle.
current_work_unit: Final external validation of stable triage and governed promotion review

completion_gates.description: Prior-art-grounded Claim/Evidence/Change model, reversible authority, dependency invalidation, and retrieval enforcement are merged.
All currently Validated legacy catalog records have first-pass Claim/Evidence representation.
Every Experimental catalog record is classified into a governed next action.
Every active Experimental catalog record has Claim-level coverage or is an explicit aggregate view.
Evidence-poor Experimental Claims have durable validation missions rather than remaining inert.
Epistemic state, triage, and validation missions are durably generated and reviewable.
All 12 promotion candidates received explicit governed review; 7 were promoted and 5 retained with concrete evidence requirements.
Final stable-triage/promotion-review change set must pass CI, merge, and regenerate durable reports on main.

notes: Project state supersedes earlier milestone-level uses of status=completed.
A completed milestone or work package must not be reported as PROJECT_COMPLETE while required project gates remain unfinished.
